clans-worker-selection-02.text: Spit it out. My back is busy.

clans-worker-selection-03.text: Tools ready. Your brains? Doubt it.

clans-worker-attack-02.text: Shut your mouth. I have bones to break.

clans-worker-attack-03.text: You picked the wrong worksite, scum.

clans-worker-gather-01.text: Hit rock. Keep bits. Even you understand.

clans-worker-gather-02.text: Chop first. Your whining comes free.

clans-worker-gather-03.text: More hauling? You lazy little runt.

clans-worker-ready-01.text: Strong back. Rotten mood. Give me work.

clans-worker-ready-02.text: Got tools. Got fists. Pick one.

clans-worker-error-01.text: No path, idiot. Want me to eat the wall?

clans-worker-humor-01.text: You said hands on deck. I ripped the door off.

clans-worker-humor-02.text: Poke me again. Lose the poking finger.

clans-worker-humor-03.text: Break a leg? Your leg or the chair leg?

clans-soldier-move-02.text: Move your arse. The axe goes first.

clans-soldier-attack-03.text: Come here, you spineless little rat!

clans-soldier-gather-01.text: Touch our supplies. Lose your hands.

clans-soldier-gather-03.text: This pile is ours. Crawl away.

clans-soldier-ready-02.text: Give me a fight, not a speech.

clans-soldier-ready-03.text: Your enemies have too many teeth.

clans-soldier-error-01.text: Too far, genius. I brought an axe.

clans-soldier-humor-01.text: Hold the line? I strangled the rope.

clans-soldier-humor-02.text: You said flank. I ate it. Tough cow.

clans-soldier-humor-03.text: Stop clicking. My axe is getting ideas.

clans-archer-selection-02.text: What now? My arrows are bored.

clans-archer-selection-03.text: Speak up, runt. Then shut up.

clans-archer-move-01.text: Fine. Keep your head below my elbow.

clans-archer-move-02.text: Moving. Stop breathing down my neck.

clans-archer-move-03.text: Out of the way. I hunt ugly things.

clans-archer-attack-02.text: Put an arrow in that mouth!

clans-archer-attack-03.text: Pin the coward to the dirt!

clans-archer-gather-01.text: Nobody steals our loot. Except us.

clans-archer-gather-02.text: Touch the tools. Meet the pointy end.

clans-archer-gather-03.text: Dig faster. I hate guard duty.

clans-archer-ready-02.text: Hunter here. Give me something annoying.

clans-archer-error-01.text: No shot, idiot. Move your big head.

clans-archer-humor-01.text: Draw the bow? I drew a pig. Looks like you.

clans-archer-humor-02.text: String along? I tied the scout to a tree.

clans-archer-humor-03.text: Keep poking. I am running out of warning arrows.

elves-worker-selection-02.text: The grove is in capable hands.

elves-worker-move-03.text: Mind the roots as we pass.

elves-worker-gather-02.text: I shall tend to the harvest.

elves-worker-error-01.text: That path is beneath even us.

elves-worker-humor-01.text: Even an oak responds to fewer knocks.

elves-worker-humor-02.text: Centuries of practice, and now this management.

elves-soldier-gather-02.text: I shall watch over the tenders.

elves-soldier-humor-01.text: I could have composed a sonnet between those clicks.

elves-soldier-humor-02.text: Repeated instructions rarely improve their quality.

elves-soldier-humor-03.text: Yes, this is my attentive expression.

elves-archer-move-03.text: I shall take the high view.

elves-archer-error-02.text: An arrow cannot reach every wish.

elves-archer-humor-01.text: My eyebrows have acknowledged the order.

elves-archer-humor-02.text: An arrow flies straighter than this conversation.

elves-archer-humor-03.text: Patience is a virtue. You may borrow some.

dwarves-worker-humor-02.text: This beard is not a bell rope.

dwarves-worker-humor-03.text: That many taps should have struck ore by now.

dwarves-soldier-humor-01.text: The shield is tested. Stop testing me.

dwarves-archer-gather-03.text: The workers can dig in peace.

dwarves-archer-humor-01.text: The bolt has less patience than I do.

dwarves-archer-humor-02.text: Do not rush craftsmanship. Especially loaded craftsmanship.

dwarves-archer-humor-03.text: Clicking is not an approved winding mechanism.

goblins-worker-humor-01.text: That button has a warranty limit.

goblins-worker-humor-02.text: Every click is another unpaid consultation.

goblins-soldier-move-02.text: Moving before the rent is due.

goblins-soldier-error-02.text: No safe route. Or unsafe route.

goblins-soldier-humor-02.text: You broke it, you bought the consultant.

goblins-soldier-humor-03.text: I am not the launch button.

goblins-archer-humor-01.text: Repeated clicks do not include express shipping.

goblins-archer-humor-02.text: Customer feedback should travel away from me.

goblins-archer-humor-03.text: The sling has fewer moving parts than your instructions.

clans-worker-humor-04.text: Boss say dig deep. Me found more dirt.

clans-worker-humor-05.text: Me build house. Roof keep falling upward wrong.

clans-soldier-humor-04.text: Me count victories on fingers. Need more fingers.

clans-soldier-humor-05.text: Me tried whispering. Broke a window.

clans-soldier-move-04.text: Me go there. There look breakable.

clans-archer-humor-04.text: Me shoot warning arrow. Arrow not good at warning.

clans-archer-humor-05.text: Me aim with both eyes. Twice as suspicious.

clans-archer-move-05.text: Me take spot. Spot better be good.

elves-worker-selection-05.text: Yes? I was improving the soil.

elves-worker-humor-05.text: I composted the criticism. It finally became useful.

elves-worker-move-05.text: I shall make that location presentable.

elves-soldier-selection-04.text: I trust this is an aesthetically sound assignment.

elves-soldier-humor-04.text: My armor reflects light and poor judgment.

elves-soldier-humor-05.text: I rehearsed victory. Your applause was late.

elves-soldier-move-04.text: A measured advance. Try to keep up.

elves-archer-selection-04.text: A keen eye. Two, in fact.

elves-archer-selection-05.text: I see the point. Usually before you do.

elves-archer-humor-04.text: My arrows have better manners than your guests.

elves-archer-humor-05.text: I missed once. The target apologized.

dwarves-worker-selection-05.text: Aye. Make it worth the blisters.

dwarves-worker-humor-05.text: My beard caught sawdust. Free insulation.

dwarves-worker-move-05.text: On the move. Keep the kettle warm.

dwarves-soldier-selection-04.text: Aye. Shield weighs less than your instructions.

dwarves-soldier-humor-04.text: My armor has dents older than your commander.

dwarves-soldier-humor-05.text: Retreat? These boots came without reverse.

dwarves-archer-humor-04.text: I measure twice and shoot once. Usually.

dwarves-archer-humor-05.text: The beard is a wind gauge. Precision equipment.

goblins-worker-humor-05.text: That smoke is a progress indicator.

goblins-worker-move-05.text: On my way. Keep the receipt.

goblins-soldier-humor-04.text: My armor is rented. Please aim elsewhere.

goblins-soldier-humor-05.text: Heroism available in three payment plans.

goblins-soldier-move-05.text: New position! Same low survival estimate.

goblins-archer-humor-04.text: Precision costs extra. Enthusiasm is included.

goblins-archer-humor-05.text: Exploding arrows? That is the premium subscription.
